perplexity.description:
Pijn’s debut EP Floodlit, released on January 27, 2017 via Holy Roar Records, marks the arrival of a distinctive voice in the post-rock and experimental rock scenes. The EP showcases Pijn’s signature blend of atmospheric textures, dynamic shifts, and intricate instrumentation, drawing comparisons to bands like Mogwai and Godspeed You! Black Emperor while establishing its own identity. The music on Floodlit balances moments of delicate melody with surges of heavy, emotive crescendos, reflecting the band’s ability to craft immersive and emotionally resonant soundscapes.

As Pijn’s first official release, Floodlit set the foundation for their evolving discography, preceding their debut full-length album Loss later that same year. The EP was well-received by critics for its ambitious arrangements and cohesive vision, with reviewers noting its compelling blend of melancholy and intensity. Though not a commercial blockbuster, Floodlit earned praise within the underground rock community for its originality and depth, solidifying Pijn’s reputation as a band to watch in the UK’s experimental rock landscape.
